fichas.title: Farmyards: Basics and Site Planning
fichas.summary: Farm location and layout should respond to topography, climate, business needs, prevailing winds, and internal and external transport connections. The page gives minimum separations between buildings, plot and area guidance, maximum route gradients, and garden requirements.

fichas.title: Planning System for a Flexible Barn Area
fichas.summary: A diagram presents a flexible barn planning system, arranging aisles and areas for straw, hay, fodder, machinery, livestock, and storage. The reproduced plan includes a repeated 5.00 grid and several other numeric labels whose exact contexts are not fully legible.
uses: Storage of straw, hay, and fodder
